# Import the dataset created in 01_Data
```{r data and dir, eval=FALSE}
events_filtered <- read.csv("01_Output/Events_data_SG_2025-10-05.csv")
```

# Hopelessness, positive/negative expectations, and perceived suicide-related coping by self-rated expectation
```{r crosssec diff}
# Make a labeled self-rated expectation variable
events_filtered <- events_filtered %>%
  mutate(q15_ssi_2_label = factor(q15_ssi_2,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("No/Unsure", "Yes")
  ))

# Data for plot
plot_data <- events_filtered %>%
  select(q15_ssi_2_label, bhs, bhs_pos, bhs_neg, srcs17) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(bhs, bhs_pos, bhs_neg, srcs17),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = recode(measure,
      bhs = "Hopelessness",
      bhs_pos = "Positive Expectations",
      bhs_neg = "Negative Expectations",
      srcs17 = "Perceived Suicide-Related Coping"
    )
  )

# Make + save the figure
tiff(paste0("04_Output/Descriptive_plot_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"), ".tiff"),
  units = "in", width = 8, height = 6, res = 300
)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = q15_ssi_2_label, y = score, fill = q15_ssi_2_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Self-Rated Expectation",
    y = "Score",
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
dev.off()
```

# Survival curve figure
```{r survival fig }
# Make a labeled self-rated expectation variable
events_filtered <- events_filtered %>%
  mutate(q15_ssi_label = factor(q15_ssi_2,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("No/Unsure", "Yes")
  ))

# Survival curve with just self-rated expectation (labeled)
cox_1a_fit <- survfit(
  Surv(surv_365, att1_365) ~
    q15_ssi_label,
  data = events_filtered
)

# Make + save the figure
tiff(paste0("04_Output/Survival_plot_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"), ".tiff"),
  units = "in", width = 8, height = 5, res = 300
)

autoplot(
  cox_1a_fit,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  censor.shape = "*",
  censor.size = 5,
  surv.size = 1.1,
  facets = TRUE,
  ncol = 2
) +
  labs(
    x = "Time to suicide attempt",
    y = "Survival",
    color = "Expectation of a future suicide attempt"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.25, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

dev.off()
```
